title: GitHub Administration (GitHub Enterprise Administrator, GH-100)
description: GitHub Administration: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the GitHub Docs words it rests on.

checks.what: Three independent audits read all 890 cards against the GitHub Docs pages they quote, found word for word by the card checker; every plan, limit, retention and billing figure was checked
checks.result: One wrong card fixed (a dormancy rule that counted issue comments as activity, which the Docs say they are not), and one scenario whose explanations called the right answer wrong; 3 ambiguous cards and 1 unsupported claim fixed; 51 unclear cards rewritten, most of them scenarios whose wrong-option reasons were not lettered; British spelling applied in prose, with GitHub's own setting names kept.
